top lib/top.shbench for Ngspice
== lib/sub.shcomp
schemify 1 shcomp
  prefix x
  category subcircuit
  provenance "xschem lib/sub.sym"
  xfp f90843bc5b3815d4

pin A in -40 0
pin Z out 40 0

impl schematic schematic
  format spice "{name} {pins} {cell}"

line -40 0 40 0
  layer 4

inst 7j6bnb core:res
  at 0 0 R0
  name R1
  value 2k

port hfz9bh 0 30 R0 Z
port sttxhh 0 -30 R0 A
== lib/top.shbench
schemify 1 shbench
  provenance "xschem lib/top.sch"
  xfp a0bcbb68f497a0d0

inst hg13j4 ./sub
  at 0 0 R0
  name x1
inst m498c8 core:res
  at 100 0 R0
  name R9
  value 5k

label 6sskm3 -40 0 R0 IN
label h6525k 40 0 R0 OUT
label kzw58s 100 30 R0 IN
label srg5dv 100 -30 R0 OUT
== schemify.project
schemify 1 project

lib lib path lib
